notes: Adds missing core logic and API/tool exposure stories to complete feature coverage.

stories.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Query Builder and Recruiting Filter Logic
stories.description: Implement core query construction against ClinicalTrials.gov API including condition keyword mapping, recruiting status filter enforcement, pagination handling, and response parsing into internal structures.

stories.title: Trial Location Extraction and Normalization
stories.description: Extract trial site locations from API response, normalize address components (city, state, zip), deduplicate locations, and prepare coordinates for downstream distance calculation.

stories.title: Travel Distance and Duration Computation via Google Routes
stories.description: Integrate Google Routes API to compute travel distance and duration from user location to each trial site, including batching, error handling, and fallback behavior when routes are unavailable.

stories.title: Tool Router Exposure for Clinical Trials Search
stories.description: Expose clinical trials search as an allowlisted tool in the tool router with validated inputs, ensuring proper dispatch, schema validation, and compatibility with Claude tool-use flow.
